data.summary:
Results-driven Fund Operations, Custody and Regulatory Compliance Specialist with 6+ years of experience across Tier-1 global custodians including BNY and Northern Trust. Strong hands-on experience across Regulatory Assurance, Regulatory Change, Regulatory Risk Assessment, Control Testing and Compliance Monitoring within fund oversight, depositary and custody operations. Experienced in CASS, CSDR, FCA, EMIR, UCITS and AIFMD regulatory requirements, with practical exposure to assessing regulatory obligations, identifying operational and control gaps, evaluating regulatory impact, performing control checks/testing and supporting remediation and governance activities.
Strong expertise in Custody & Depositary Operations, client/fund asset oversight, depositary due diligence, securities and cash operations, derivatives reconciliation and independent NAV validation. Experienced in reviewing operational processes and controls against regulatory requirements, updating SOPs and implementing control enhancements in response to regulatory and business changes. Demonstrated ability to work with Operations, Risk, Compliance, Technology, Fund Accounting, Trustee/Depositary and external stakeholders to strengthen control environments, resolve exceptions, support regulatory assurance activities and maintain operational and regulatory compliance across global institutional businesses.

raw_sections.experience:
E X P E R I E N C E
BNY (Bank of New York) Specialist II – Fund Oversight & Depositary Compliance | Pune, India
2023 – Present
▸ Led the end-to-end operational transition of Trustee and Depositary Business from Ireland & UK to Pune, enabling seamless continuity of service for
global institutional clients — recognised with VIP Award by BNY Management.
▸ Ensured UCITS, AIFMD, CASS, CSDR, FCA and EMIR regulatory compliance by monitoring applicable investment, fund and custody-related activities
and ensuring adherence to regulatory requirements and internal policies.
▸ Performed regulatory assurance and compliance monitoring across Trustee and Depositary activities, reviewing operational processes and controls to
identify exceptions, control gaps and areas requiring corrective action.
▸ Conducted regulatory risk assessments and impact assessments for regulatory and business changes, evaluating potential impacts on fund oversight,
custody and depositary processes and supporting implementation of required control and process enhancements.
▸ Performed control reviews and testing across relevant fund oversight and depositary processes, validating adherence to defined procedures,
regulatory requirements and internal control standards and supporting resolution of identified exceptions.
▸ Performed depositary due diligence reconciliations across multi-asset classes including OTC Derivatives, Private Equity, Bank Debt, Mutual Funds, and
Equities — investigating aged breaks, identifying root causes and supporting remediation to reduce reconciliation failure rates.
▸ Executed independent NAV validation and oversight of Fund Administration operations, ensuring accuracy of fund accounting records submitted by
third-party administrators and supporting effective operational and regulatory oversight.
▸ Supported regulatory assurance and audit reviews by maintaining control evidence, reconciliation records, compliance documentation and supporting
materials required for governance, risk, compliance and audit activities.
▸ Reviewed and validated dividend calculations provided by Fund Accounting teams; prepared and distributed declaration letters to investment
managers and external stakeholders in accordance with regulatory timelines.
▸ Leveraged ICE Connect, Geneva, InvestOne, Rufus, and Alto to automate compliance tracking and produce management information reports using
advanced Excel and Power BI dashboards.
▸ Conducted periodic reviews and updates of SOPs to incorporate regulatory and operational changes, strengthen control procedures and ensure
continued alignment with applicable requirements.
▸ Identified control and process gaps and supported remediation activities, working with Operations, Risk, Compliance, Fund Accounting, Technology
and other stakeholders to strengthen governance and operational controls.
▸ Mentored analysts and interns during the operational transition, accelerating capability build and maintaining SLA adherence throughout the ramp-up
period.
▸ Performed regulatory change assessments for applicable CASS, CSDR, FCA and EMIR requirements, evaluating the impact of regulatory updates on
fund oversight, custody and depositary processes and identifying required process or control changes.
▸ Reviewed regulatory and operational control gaps across depositary and fund oversight activities, performing root-cause analysis where required and
supporting remediation through process, control and SOP enhancements.
▸ Supported CASS and CSDR-related compliance activities within the custody/depositary environment, reviewing relevant operational processes and
controls and coordinating with stakeholders to address identified exceptions and compliance requirements.
▸ Supported FCA and EMIR-related compliance requirements applicable to relevant fund, custody and OTC derivative activities, including review of
operational adherence, control requirements and supporting documentation.
▸ Maintained regulatory assurance evidence and documentation including control records, reconciliation outputs, review results, SOPs and supporting
documentation for governance, compliance and audit requirements.
Northern Trust Analyst II – Custody & Cash Operations | Pune, India
2021 – 2023
▸ ▸ Processed FX and corporate action transactions for APAC and EMEA institutional clients in accordance with client mandates, market
requirements and internal control procedures.
▸ Managed custody and cash operations supporting timely settlement, cash movements and resolution of operational exceptions across global
client portfolios.
▸ Liaised with Agent Banks, internal operations and client service teams to resolve custody settlement exceptions, payment issues and
transaction discrepancies.
▸ Performed reconciliation and validation activities across custody and cash processes, identifying operational breaks and supporting timely
resolution.
▸ Supported adherence to custody-related regulatory and internal control requirements, escalating exceptions and operational risks to
relevant stakeholders.
▸ Liaised with Agent Banks to ensure timely payment action and resolved custody settlement queries in coordination with internal operations and client
service teams.
▸ Developed an MS Excel macro that eliminated manual processing errors and improved team throughput — recognized as Rising Star at Northern
Trust.
▸ Awarded Exceptional Performer in the Cash Telex team (Top performer among 13 members) for consistently exceeding performance targets set by
management.
MICA Educational Company Pvt Ltd (Govt. of Jharkhand) Compliance Analyst – Mukhyamantri Jan Samvad Kendra (State Grievance Redressal Project)
2018 – 2020
▸ Served as Compliance Analyst for Planning Cum Finance and Urban Development Departments, reviewing grievance nature and ATR
submissions from nodal officers.
▸ Prepared daily reports on grievance registration and resolution, tracking SLA adherence and escalating unresolved cases to senior
stakeholders within TAT.
▸ Coordinated with nodal officers for priority closure of high-urgency grievances, contributing to improved citizen satisfaction and departmental
compliance scores.
